units.source_text: 薰中纳言常常睹物怀人，时刻不忘大女公子，

en.t: Kaoru, the Middle Counselor, was constantly reminded of her by everything he saw and never forgot the elder princess.

units.source_text: 故对二女公子说道：“我从小厌恶尘世，常想清心寡欲地度此一生。

en.t: So he said to the second princess, "Since childhood I have hated the dust of this world and have always wished to live out my life with a pure heart and few desires.

units.source_text: 然而恐是前世因缘注定之故，我虽常受令姐冷遇，而对她刻骨相思难忘。

en.t: Yet perhaps because it was fated by bonds from a former life, though your sister often treated me coldly, my longing for her was carved into my bones and impossible to forget.

units.source_text: 因此之故，本来的道心终于逐渐消失。

en.t: Because of that, the religious resolve I once had gradually disappeared at last.

units.source_text: 为欲慰情，我也常想结识几个女子，看看她们的模样，或可排遣哀思。

en.t: Wanting to console my feelings, I often thought of becoming acquainted with several women, to see what they were like and perhaps dispel my sorrow.

units.source_text: 然而别的女子更无一人可以使我倾慕。

en.t: But among other women there was not a single one who could make me feel admiration or love.

units.source_text: 经过万般苦思之后，确信世间没有一个女子能牵惹我心。

en.t: After every kind of painful reflection, I became convinced that there was no woman in the world who could stir my heart.

units.source_text: 所以如果有人把我当作好色之徒，我心甚觉可耻。

en.t: So if anyone takes me for a lecherous man, I feel deeply ashamed in my heart.

units.source_text: 今我对你如果稍有半点不良之心，自不足道。

en.t: If I now had even the slightest improper feeling toward you, I would of course be beneath all mention.

units.source_text: 然而仅乎如此对晤，常把我心所思之事奉告，或者倾听你的谈话，

en.t: But if it is only meeting like this, telling you what is in my heart, or listening to what you say,

units.source_text: 彼此开诚畅谈，谁复能责咎呢？

en.t: and speaking frankly and openly with each other, who could possibly blame us?

units.source_text: 我心与众不同，一向正直无私，世间无人能非难我，还请你信任我吧。”

en.t: My heart is unlike other people's; it has always been honest and free of selfishness. No one in the world can reproach me, so please trust me."

units.source_text: 他满怀怨恨，啼啼哭哭地说这番话。

en.t: His heart full of resentment, he spoke these words while weeping and sobbing.

units.source_text: 二女公子答道：“我如果不信任你，怎么会不顾旁人疑怪，如此接近地招待你呢？

en.t: The second princess answered, "If I did not trust you, how could I disregard other people's suspicions and receive you so closely like this?

units.source_text: 多年以来蒙你种种照拂，深感厚意。

en.t: For many years I have received all kinds of care from you, and I deeply appreciate your kindness.

units.source_text: 因此我把你看作特别可靠之人，此次曾经主动写信给你呢。”

en.t: That is why I regard you as someone especially dependable, and this time I even wrote to you of my own accord."

units.source_text: 薰中纳言说：“你几时主动写信给我，我根本记不起来了。

en.t: Kaoru, the Middle Counselor, said, "I cannot remember at all when you ever wrote to me of your own accord.

units.source_text: 你的话说得多甜蜜啊！

en.t: How sweetly you say such things!

units.source_text: 大约是指：为了准备赴宇治山乡，才写信来召唤我吧？

en.t: You must mean that you wrote to summon me so you could prepare to go to the mountain village at Uji, is that it?

units.source_text: 我也确是蒙你信任，我心岂不感激？”

en.t: It is true that you trusted me, so how could my heart fail to be grateful?"

units.source_text: 他说时还是满怀怨恨。

en.t: Even as he said this, his heart was still full of resentment.

units.source_text: 但因旁边有人听见，未便任情罄谈。

en.t: But because someone nearby could hear them, it was not convenient to pour out everything he felt.

units.source_text: 他向窗外凝神眺望，但见天色渐渐幽暗，虫声历历可闻。

en.t: He gazed intently out the window and saw the sky gradually darkening, while the cries of insects could be heard clearly.

units.source_text: 庭中假山只见黑影，此外景色都已不能分辨。

en.t: In the garden, the artificial hill was visible only as a black silhouette, and everything else could no longer be distinguished.

units.source_text: 帘内的二女公子见他只管悄然不动地靠柱坐着，心中十分着急。

en.t: Behind the blinds, the second princess saw him sitting silently and motionlessly against a pillar, and she grew very anxious.

units.source_text: 薰中纳言低声吟诵古歌“人世恋情原有限……”，接着说道：“苦痛忍受不住了！

en.t: Kaoru, the Middle Counselor, softly recited the old poem, "Love in this world has its limit..." Then he continued, "I can no longer endure this pain!

units.source_text: 我很想到‘无音乡’去呢。

en.t: I very much want to go to the 'soundless village.'

units.source_text: 至少，到宇治山乡去，即使不特建寺院，

en.t: At the very least, I want to go to the mountain village at Uji, and even if I do not build a temple especially for her,

units.source_text: 也要依照故人面影雕一个肖像，绘一幅画像，当作佛像，礼拜诵念。”

en.t: I will have a statue carved and a portrait painted in the likeness of the departed one, and worship and pray before them as Buddhist images."

units.source_text: 二女公子说：“你发这个心愿，真正令人感动！

en.t: The second princess said, "For you to form such a wish is truly moving.

units.source_text: 不过说起雕像，教人联想起放入‘洗手川’里的偶像，反而对不起亡姐了。

en.t: But when you speak of a carved figure, it makes one think of the dolls placed in the Mitarashi River, and that would instead wrong my late sister.

units.source_text: 至于画像呢，世间有看黄金多少而定容貌美丑的画师，所以也是不放心的。”

en.t: As for a painted portrait, there are artists in the world who decide beauty or ugliness according to how much gold they receive, so that too makes me uneasy."

units.source_text: 薰中纳言说：“对啊！这雕匠和画师，怎能依照我的意思而造像呢！

en.t: Kaoru, the Middle Counselor, said, "Yes, exactly! How could such sculptors and painters create an image according to my wishes?

units.source_text: 听说近世有一个雕匠，所雕的佛像真个能使天花乱坠。

en.t: I have heard that in recent times there is a sculptor whose Buddhist images are so marvelous they can truly make heavenly flowers fall.

units.source_text: 但愿有这等神工鬼斧才好。”

en.t: If only there were such divine craftsmanship available."

units.source_text: 讲来讲去，总忘不了大女公子。

en.t: Whatever he said, in the end he still could not forget the elder princess.

units.source_text: 神色如此悲伤，显见其富于深情。

en.t: His expression was so sorrowful that it plainly showed the depth and richness of his feeling.
